identityBoundary.rule: Tenant content may use only its own approved identity. knownForeignBrandTokens is a test-only sentinel used to prove isolation; a real foreign-tenant identity token is neither required nor permitted in normal tenant configuration.

externalReadiness.reason: This scaffold creates only internal plans, empty registries, and placeholder evidence requirements.

dataPlane.tenantRuntime: A private tenant repository and separately controlled backend are required before any real data exists.
dataPlane.crossTenantLearning: Only approved aggregate_deidentified LearningExport records may leave a tenant after a future gate.
